Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. GST Certificate, PAN Card, Aadhar Card 3. Last three years' income tax return with a valid balance sheet 4. Last Three Months of GST-Filled Return 3B

5. Bidder must upload ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, and 45001:2018 certifications. 6. All bidders are requested to upload all certificates, such as OEM Authorization, Warranty, Esc matrix, an d Tollfree no., which must have a valid date or during tender tenure. 7. Contractors/bidders shall be authorized by the OEM, and a certificate for participating in the tender is m andatory to be enclosed with bid documents 8. Conditional bids are not acceptable. 9. The undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all the bids without assigning any reason. Minimum qualifying criteria for LED product manufacturer/supplier: 1. The bidder should submit the UP PWD AAA Certificate, BIS, and CRS-approved fitting certifications. 2. The bidder should submit a 5-year warranty certificate for the LED floodlight on OEM letterhead. 3. It is compulsory to upload the factory license of the LED manufacturer along with the BID. 4. OEM must have an in-house NABL lab in its manufacturing plant; the certificate needs to be uploaded al ong with the bid documents. 5. OEM should have manufacturing plant in India with In-house NABL Lab, with in-house SMT, MCPCB machi nes, its Own driver manufacturing unit, C- and B-type photogoniometers, Automatic assembly lines, etc. 6. The OEM of the offered products must submit a declaration on letterhead stating that the OEM company has not been blacklisted or debarred by any government, semi-government, or PSU department for any re ason as of the date. 7. The OEM and its reseller both must have ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, and 45001:2018 certifications. 8. EMD is compulsory for participation in this bid; a copy of the EMD must be attached with the documents. No exemption will be given, whether it is OEM or resellers. 9. The bidder must mandatorily submit authorization from the OEM for the offered products and an authori zation certificate for participating in the specific tender, both of which must be enclosed with the bid docu ments. 10. Bidder must submit all relevant documents like CRS, BIS, TDS, LM79, LM80, IP, TTC, Photobiology, NAB L In-house Lab in its manufacturing plant, Incorporation, and Trademark Certifications 11. OEMs must have their manufacturing plants in India (they must attach a valid document). 12. The LED floodlight and its driver must be of the same make. 13. All bidders are requested to upload all certificates, such as warranty, ESC matrix, and toll-free no., whi ch must have a valid date or be during the tender period. 14. An OEM authorization certificate is required, along with the employee's name, mobile number, designa tion, and email, to confirm any queries or bidder-related information. 15. Both the manufacturer and the supplied product must be registered in the UP PWD CAT AAA SOR; plea se submit the documentary evidence. and bidder must submit an advanced sample of an LED floodlight in Nagar Panchayat office. Technical Documents Required from HM Octagonal Pole Manufacturer: 1. The bidder must submit all relevant documents, like BIS, TDS, wind tunnel report, type test report, hot-d ip 7-tank galvanizing process, UP PWD CAT AAA, and OEM authorization letter. 2. As per the Govt. of India program (MEITY), the product manufacturer must have a manufacturing facilityi n India to promote “MAKE IN INDIA." a) Factory License b) ISO 9001 c) ISO 14001 d) ISO 45001 .
